name: Al2O3 corundum
citation: A. Kirfel and K. Eichhorn. Accurate structure analysis with synchrotron radiation. The electron density in Al2O3 and Cu2O. Acta Crystallographica Section A 46 (1990), 271-284.
recommendation: recommended first-round source candidate; FEFF validation pending
method: Experimental room-temperature single-crystal synchrotron X-ray diffraction; author preprint abstract confirms method and room temperature.
synthesis_conditions: Synthetic Verneuil-grown crystal, as stated in the author preprint; exact growth temperature not recorded here.
notes: Room temperature is stated by the original author preprint but no exact numeric measurement temperature is verified; no conversion to a nominal room-temperature value.
Raw CIF is COD copy of AMCSD0009327; keep its article-attribution notice.
The source CIF has no atom occupancy column; parser treats sites as fully occupied. This is not an explicit occupancy measurement.
Pressure is not numerically specified in the inspected source; leave measurement_pressure_GPa null.

license.database_policy: COD dedicates its data/database to the public domain under CC0; retain original article attribution and original file notice.
license.original_file_notice: CIF header identifies AMCSD as original data provider and requests proper attribution to the journal article.
